card.title: I Earn My Seat
card.instruction: Behave as though belonging must be justified through performance. Make your competence visible whenever your right to participate feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've repaired the stage lights. Is there room for me in the theatre group now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come to a rehearsal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to audition for the audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll time my laughs so nobody loses a line. You'll want me in the front row.

mechanism: A treats theatre participation as something to earn through useful, visible competence.
confusable: Unlike eagerness, even an invitation without audition must provoke a performance that justifies belonging.
comparison: S196-b turns permission to watch into expertly timed laughter; S196-a offers records toward a formal vote.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
